action.objective: Verify Qxb5 (d5b5) as the strongest candidate at full depth 4.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search gave d5b5 an exact 182, top of the list, with reserved verification nodes. d5b5 wins a pawn (b5) and keeps the queen active, pre-empting Black's loose b5 pawn structure. Verify at max depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes.
